---
name: "nf-core/fastq_remove_rrna"
description: "Remove ribosomal RNA reads from FASTQ files using SortMeRNA, RiboDetector,\
  \ or Bowtie2"
keywords:
- "fastq"
- "rrna"
- "ribosomal"
- "filter"
- "sortmerna"
- "ribodetector"
- "bowtie2"
components:
- "bowtie2/align"
- "bowtie2/build"
- "ribodetector"
- "samtools/fastq"
- "samtools/view"
- "seqkit/replace"
- "seqkit/stats"
- "sortmerna"
input:
- ch_reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "List of FastQ files of size 1 and 2 for single-end and paired-end\
      \ data, respectively.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fq,fastq}{,.gz}"
- ch_rrna_fastas:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing one or more FASTA files with rRNA sequences for\
      \ use with SortMeRNA or Bowtie2.\nNot required for RiboDetector which uses built-in\
      \ models.\n\nStructure: [ path(fasta) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fa,fasta}{,.gz}"
- ch_sortmerna_index:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Pre-built SortMeRNA index directory. Optional - can be built on-the-fly\
      \ if make_sortmerna_index is true.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(index) ]\n"
- ch_bowtie2_index:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Pre-built Bowtie2 index directory. Optional - can be built on-the-fly\
      \ if make_bowtie2_index is true.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(index) ]\n"
- ribo_removal_tool:
    type: "string"
    description: "Specifies the rRNA removal tool to use"
    enum:
    - "sortmerna"
    - "ribodetector"
    - "bowtie2"
- make_sortmerna_index:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether to create SortMeRNA index before running SortMeRNA"
- make_bowtie2_index:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether to create Bowtie2 index before running Bowtie2 for rRNA\
      \ removal"
output:
- reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "FASTQ files with rRNA reads removed.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fq,fastq}{,.gz}"
- multiqc_files:
    type: "file"
    description: "Log files from the rRNA removal tool, compatible with MultiQC.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
- sortmerna_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "SortMeRNA log file, only populated when sortmerna is the rRNA removal\
      \ tool.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.log"
- ribodetector_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "RiboDetector log file, only populated when ribodetector is the rRNA\
      \ removal tool.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.log"
- seqkit_stats:
    type: "file"
    description: "SeqKit statistics used to derive the mean read length for RiboDetector,\
      \ only\npopulated when ribodetector is the rRNA removal tool.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(stats) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.tsv"
- bowtie2_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "Bowtie2 alignment log files, only populated when bowtie2 is the\
      \ rRNA removal tool.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.log"
- bowtie2_index:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Bowtie2 index built from the rRNA references, only populated when\
      \ bowtie2 is the\nrRNA removal tool and make_bowtie2_index is true.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(index) ]\n"
- seqkit_prefixed:
    type: "file"
    description: "rRNA reference fasta files with their filename added as a prefix\
      \ to each sequence\nheader, only populated when a Bowtie2 index is built.\n\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path(fasta) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fa,fasta}{,.gz}"
- seqkit_converted:
    type: "file"
    description: "Prefixed rRNA reference fasta files with U bases converted to T,\
      \ only populated\nwhen a Bowtie2 index is built.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(fasta) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fa,fasta}{,.gz}"
authors:
- "@pinin4fjords"
maintainers:
- "@pinin4fjords"
version: "0.0.0-df69bf6"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/bowtie2/align@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/bowtie2/build@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/ribodetector@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/samtools/fastq@0.0.0-df69bf6"
  - "nf-core/samtools/view@0.0.0-df69bf6"
  - "nf-core/seqkit/replace@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/seqkit/stats@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/sortmerna@0.0.0-6d1763b"
